definitions.explanation: an unreasonable accusation or complaint made without proper basis, often to pick a fight or find fault

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}い{掛|が}かりだ。
{言|い}い{掛|が}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけられて⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I was troubled by someone picking a fight with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い→酔っ払い：09429_yopparai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{掛|が}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけられた。
examples.english: A drunk person started an argument with me over nothing.

notes:
{言|い}い{掛|が}かり refers to an unreasonable or fabricated accusation, often made as a pretext to start a confrontation or find fault.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {言|い}い{掛|が}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to make a baseless accusation, to pick a fight
- {言|い}い{掛|が}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけられる→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to be falsely accused
- {言|い}い{掛|が}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧くる: to come at someone with unfounded complaints

USAGE:
Always implies the complaint has no legitimate basis — the accuser is either looking for trouble or making excuses. Common in situations involving ⟦{酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い→酔っ払い：09429_yopparai⟧ (drunks), unreasonable customers, or bullying.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{因縁|いんねん}→因縁：07460_innen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to pick a quarrel (more intimidating)
- ⟦{難癖|なんくせ}→難癖：15237_nankuse⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to find fault, nitpick (persistent criticism)
- ⟦{八|や}つ{当|あ}たり→八つ当たり：08362_yatsuatari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take frustrations out on someone
